_comment: Corpus cases DBDiff does not pass yet, keyed by data set name, with why.
A listed case must still fail, and one that passes fails the suite until it
is removed, so this can only shrink. See tests/Support/CorpusKnownFailures.php.

migrations.objects_in_quoted_schema (before → after: DBDiff compares the public schema only; objects in any other schema are not seen, so the databases read as identical.
migrations.objects_in_another_schema (before → afte: DBDiff compares the public schema only; objects in any other schema are not seen, so the databases read as identical.
migrations.sequence_shared_and_owned_with_options (: A standalone sequence owned by a column is treated as that column's serial: its options are lost, and it is not dropped when the source has none.
migrations.partitions_added_with_default_and_index: A new index on a partitioned table is created before the new partitions, and does not reach them.
migrations.trigger_with_condition_and_indexed_matvi: A trigger with a WHEN condition, with its function and an indexed materialized view, does not round-trip.
